name: Violet-Red (PerBang)
lede: Violet-Red (PerBang) is a pink named by the Japanese color-reference site PerBang, filed in our data as a family-word variant of [[violet]].

sections.title: A web color list's pink
sections.body:
Our only source for this name is Wikipedia's color list, which attributes it to PerBang; no coining story or date survives in our sources [1]. It is grouped in our data as a "violet" family-word rather than a Crayola or paint-brand name [1].

Its nearest look-alikes are [[rose-color]] (2.8 units, almost the same), [[medium-pink]] (3.0, almost the same) and [[barbie-pink]] (3.3, more vivid) [2].

In LCH terms it measures lightness 60, chroma 64 and hue 355 degrees, just past red into the pink range [2]. The "violet" in its name is a family label in our data rather than a visible trace of violet or purple in the hue itself [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive holds this color across at least one percent of its canvas, as photographed; this bright a pink is uncommon in aged, varnished paint [3].
